id_weather_areas.desc: List starter BMKG adm4 village codes (for example Jakarta Pusat Kemayoran = 31.71.03.1001). No API key required.

response.license: Follow BMKG website terms; attribution to BMKG is required

id_weather_overview.desc: Get BMKG 3-hourly weather overview text for a village adm4 code.

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

response.license: Follow BMKG website terms; attribution to BMKG is required

data.text: DKI Jakarta: partly cloudy to rain this afternoon. Temperature around 26–33°C, humidity 65–90%.

id_weather_week_overview.desc: Get BMKG 3-day weather overview for a village adm4 code (BMKG public forecast horizon).

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

response.license: Follow BMKG website terms; attribution to BMKG is required

data.text: Day 1 rain possible afternoon. Day 2 partly cloudy. Day 3 isolated showers.

id_weather_warnings.desc: Extract rain/storm/fog slots from the BMKG village forecast. No API key required.

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

response.license: Follow BMKG website terms; attribution to BMKG is required

id_weather_24h.desc: Get 24-hour forecast (temperature, humidity, wind, rain, weather code) for a BMKG adm4 area_code.

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

id_weather_4day.desc: Get 4-day forecast (conditions, temperature range, precipitation sum) for a BMKG adm4 area_code.

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

id_uv_index.desc: Get hourly UV index readings for a BMKG adm4 area_code (no API key required).

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

id_rainfall.desc: Get hourly rainfall readings for a BMKG adm4 area_code (no API key required).

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

id_air_temperature.desc: Get hourly air temperature readings for a BMKG adm4 area_code (no API key required).

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

id_relative_humidity.desc: Get hourly relative humidity readings for a BMKG adm4 area_code (no API key required).

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

id_air_quality.desc: Get hourly air quality (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3, SO2, CO, European AQI) for a BMKG adm4 area_code. No API key required.

params.name: area_code
params.desc: BMKG adm4 village code, for example '31.71.03.1001' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

id_earthquake_list.desc: List recent BMKG earthquakes (latest, M 5.0+, felt). No API key required.

response.license: Follow BMKG website terms; attribution to BMKG is required

id_tsunami_list.desc: List recent BMKG earthquake events with tsunami potential. No API key required.

response.license: Follow BMKG website terms; attribution to BMKG is required

id_flood_reports.desc: Get recent Jakarta flood / inundation reports from PetaBencana.id. No API key required.

id_volcanoes.desc: Search Indonesian volcanoes by name, type, or height. MAGMA official REST is not public; this uses a static catalog. No API key required.

id_address_search.desc: Search Indonesian addresses, place names, and landmarks using OpenStreetMap Nominatim. No API key required.

params.name: query
params.desc: Indonesian address or place name, for example 'Monas' or 'Jl. Thamrin Jakarta'.

id_geocode.desc: Convert an Indonesian address or place name to latitude/longitude using Nominatim.

params.name: query
params.desc: Indonesian address or place name to geocode.

id_reverse_geocode.desc: Convert latitude/longitude to an Indonesian address using Nominatim. No API key required.

params.name: latitude
params.desc: Latitude, for example -6.175392 for Monas, Jakarta.

params.name: longitude
params.desc: Longitude, for example 106.827153 for Monas, Jakarta.

id_postal_code.desc: Convert a 5-digit Indonesian postal code to province/city/district/village via CariKodePos. No API key required.

id_elevation.desc: Get elevation (meters) for a latitude/longitude using Open-Meteo DEM. No API key required.

id_provinces.desc: List all Indonesian provinces with Kemendagri codes. No API key required.

response.agency: Kemendagri codes via EMSIFA static JSON

id_regencies.desc: List kabupaten/kota for a province Kemendagri code (for example '31' = DKI Jakarta). No API key required.

params.name: province_id
params.desc: 2-digit province code, for example '31' for DKI Jakarta.

response.agency: Kemendagri codes via EMSIFA static JSON

id_districts.desc: List kecamatan for a kabupaten/kota code (for example '3173' = Jakarta Pusat). No API key required.

params.name: regency_id
params.desc: 4-digit regency/city code, for example '3173' for Kota Jakarta Pusat.

response.agency: Kemendagri codes via EMSIFA static JSON

id_villages.desc: List desa/kelurahan for a kecamatan code (for example '3173060' = Kemayoran). No API key required.

params.name: district_id
params.desc: District code, for example '3173060' for Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat.

response.agency: Kemendagri codes via EMSIFA static JSON

id_public_holidays.desc: List Indonesian public holidays for a calendar year via Nager.Date. No API key required.

id_cuti_bersama.desc: List Indonesian national holidays and joint leave (cuti bersama) for a year. Complements id_public_holidays. No API key required.

params.name: cuti_only
params.desc: If true, return cuti bersama rows only.

id_evacuation_shelters.desc: List nearby evacuation / emergency assembly points from OpenStreetMap. Provide lat/lon. No API key required.

params.name: latitude
params.desc: Latitude, for example -6.175392 for Monas, Jakarta.

params.name: longitude
params.desc: Longitude, for example 106.827153 for Monas, Jakarta.

params.name: type
params.desc: 'evacuation' = shelters / assembly points, 'emergency' = emergency assembly points only.

id_disease_reports.desc: Search HDX Indonesia datasets for infectious-disease related open data (dengue, malaria, etc.). No API key required.

response.license: Per-dataset license (often CC BY); follow HDX terms

id_parse_nik.desc: Locally decode a 16-digit NIK (province/regency/district codes, date of birth, gender). Format parser only — does not validate identity against Dukcapil. No HTTP and no API key.

id_kpu_election_2024.desc: Historical 2024 presidential (PPWP) archive from KPU SIREKAP public JSON. Not a live election tool. No API key required.

params.name: view
params.desc: candidates = paslon list, wilayah = province/regency tree, results = vote tallies.

params.name: wilayah_codes
params.desc: Optional nested KPU codes, for example '31' (DKI Jakarta) or '31/3173'.

id_heroes.desc: Search Indonesian national heroes (pahlawan nasional). No API key required.

id_tourism_spots.desc: Search nearby tourism spots (attractions, museums, viewpoints, etc.) via OpenStreetMap Overpass. No API key required.

id_krl_stations.desc: List KAI Commuter (KRL) stations for Jabodetabek and Yogyakarta-Solo via the public Comuline API. No API key required.

params.name: query
params.desc: Optional station id or name filter, for example 'MRI' or 'manggarai'.

id_krl_schedule.desc: Get KAI Commuter (KRL) departures for a station code (MRI, GMR, AC, …) via Comuline. No API key required.

params.name: station_id
params.desc: Comuline station id, for example 'MRI' (Manggarai) or 'GMR' (Gambir).

params.name: line
params.desc: Optional line name filter, for example 'BOGOR' or 'CIKARANG'.

id_news.desc: Get latest Indonesian news headlines from CNN, CNBC, Detik, Kompas, Tempo, or Republika. No API key required.

params.name: source
params.desc: News source slug: cnn-news, cnbc-news, detik-news, kompas-news, tempo-news, republika-news.

id_news_category.desc: Get Indonesian news headlines for a source category (for example CNN nasional). No API key required.

params.name: category
params.desc: Category slug. CNN: nasional, internasional, ekonomi, olahraga, teknologi, hiburan, gaya-hidup.

id_news_search.desc: Search Indonesian headlines by title/snippet on CNN, CNBC, Detik, Kompas, Tempo, or Republika. No API key required.

params.name: category
params.desc: Optional category slug for the chosen source.

id_faskes.desc: Search nearby hospitals and clinics via OpenStreetMap Overpass. OSM community data — not an official Kemenkes directory. No API key required.

response.agency: OpenStreetMap contributors (hospitals/clinics — not an official Kemenkes directory)

id_bi_finance.desc: Get Bank Indonesia USD/IDR (and other pairs) via Frankfurter. Default returns the latest USD/IDR rate. No API key required.

params.name: include_metadata
params.desc: If true, also return provider metadata.

id_gold_price.desc: Get current Antam / logam mulia gold sell and buyback prices in IDR. No API key required.

params.name: source
params.desc: Gold price source slug: anekalogam, hargaemas-org, lakuemas, pegadaian, indogold.

response.agency: Community gold prices (Aneka Logam / Antam listings)

id_banks.desc: Search Indonesian banks by name (BRI, Mandiri, BCA, etc.) with OJK type and contact details. No API key required.

params.name: keyword
params.desc: Bank name keyword, for example 'bri', 'mandiri', or 'bca'.

id_ojk_invest.desc: Search unofficial OJK lists of illegal investments, legal mutual-fund apps, or investment products. No API key required.

params.name: query
params.desc: Optional name filter, for example 'binary' or 'bibit'.

response.agency: Otoritas Jasa Keuangan public investment lists

id_indodax_ticker.desc: Get a public Indodax crypto ticker (no API key). Default pair is BTC/IDR.

params.name: pair
params.desc: Indodax market pair, for example 'btcidr', 'ethidr', or 'usdtidr'.

id_kbbi.desc: Look up an Indonesian word in Kamus Besar Bahasa Indonesia. No API key required.

id_prayer_cities.desc: Search MyQuran/Kemenag city ids for Islamic prayer schedules. No API key required.

id_prayer_schedule.desc: Get monthly Islamic prayer times (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for a MyQuran city id. No API key required.

params.name: city_id
params.desc: MyQuran city id, for example '1301' for Kota Jakarta.

id_quran_list.desc: List all 114 Quran surahs with Latin names and ayah counts via EQuran.id. No API key required.

id_quran_surah.desc: Get a Quran surah with Arabic, Latin, and Indonesian text via EQuran.id. No API key required.

id_hadith.desc: Get a hadith by narrator slug and number via MyQuran, or list narrators when list_narrators is true. No API key required.

params.name: list_narrators
params.desc: If true, return the narrator (perawi) catalog instead of a hadith.

params.name: number
params.desc: Hadith number within the narrator collection.

id_doa.desc: Search Indonesian daily doa (prayers) with Arabic, Latin, and meaning. No API key required.

params.name: query
params.desc: Optional title/meaning filter, for example 'tidur' or 'makan'.

doa.title: Doa sebelum makan
doa.id: Ya Allah, berkahilah rezeki yang Engkau berikan

id_asmaul_husna.desc: List the 99 names of Allah (Asmaul Husna) in Arabic, Latin, and Indonesian. No API key required.

params.name: number
params.desc: Optional name number 1-99. Omit to return all 99 names.

id_datasets_search.desc: Search HDX Indonesia open datasets via CKAN package_search. No API key required.

params.name: fq
params.desc: Optional CKAN filter query. Defaults to 'groups:idn'.

response.license: Per-dataset license (often CC BY); follow HDX terms

id_dataset_show.desc: Get full HDX dataset metadata and resources by package id or name. No API key required.

params.name: id
params.desc: CKAN package id or name, for example 'cod-ab-idn' or 'wfp-food-prices-for-indonesia'.

response.license: Per-dataset license (often CC BY); follow HDX terms

id_dataset_metadata.desc: Alias of id_dataset_show for Singapore-style naming. Get HDX package metadata by id/name.

params.name: id
params.desc: CKAN package id or name, for example 'cod-ab-idn'.

response.license: Per-dataset license (often CC BY); follow HDX terms

id_dataset_query.desc: Query tabular HDX datastore records by resource_id (CKAN datastore_search). No API key required.

params.name: resource_id
params.desc: CKAN resource id that has datastore enabled.

params.name: q
params.desc: Optional full-text query across datastore fields.

params.name: filters
params.desc: Optional JSON filters string, for example '{"col":"value"}'.

params.name: sort
params.desc: Optional sort expression, for example 'col asc'.

params.name: fields
params.desc: Optional comma-separated field list to return.

response.license: Per-dataset license (often CC BY); follow HDX terms
